title: redact: the local model's cues match inside words (tool_call cues a phone, telemetry too)
head: e60d14a891340ebd7e10201e81d6acf51c4e10ea
testCommands: GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.8 GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 go build -tags nogui ./...
unverifiedBoundaries: The real local model over agent requests: the table is the cue set the issue named, not a replay of its 3 MB corpus.
The 40-byte window is byte-based: a cue that begins before the window is not matched, as before.

A cue that follows an underscore is matched only as a whole cue of its own (api_key, apikey, account_number's account ends at a join); a snake_case name whose cue is its last segment only (OPENAI_API_KEY's key) no longer cues the model, its rule's KEY= context still masks it.
